entries.zh: 尊堂：尊称他人母亲的敬语
entries.en: your honorable mother; honorific term for another person's mother
entries.notes: 官话栏[残]，据西语 madre señora（敬称）与汉字'尊堂'、音 chūn tōng 三栏互证定释义

entries.zh: 令堂：敬称对方的母亲
entries.en: your esteemed mother (honorific for 'your mother')
entries.notes: 官话栏[残]，据西语敬称用法与汉字'令堂'、音 lěng tōng 互证定释义

entries.zh: 大婆：正妻、嫡配；亦谓亲生嫡母
entries.en: principal/lawful wife; one's own legitimate mother
entries.notes: 官话栏[残]；西语 'madre propia'（亲生之母）与汉字'大婆'（正妻）合参，取嫡母、正妻义

entries.zh: 考妣：已故的父母；先考先妣
entries.en: deceased parents; one's departed father and mother
entries.notes: 官话栏[残]；西语 'madre después de muerta'（母殁之后）与汉字'考妣'、音 cò pí 合证

entries.zh: 包胎：怀胎、孕育（谓胎儿在母腹中成形）
entries.en: conception, pregnancy; the child formed in the mother's womb
entries.notes: 西语句读残乱（marido se forma la criatura）且官话栏[残]，据汉字'包（保/抱）胎'与音 pâu tâi 推为怀胎义

entries.zh: 港路：河道水路，江海口之主航道
entries.en: the main channel of a river; harbor waterway
entries.notes: 官话栏[残]；西语 'madre del río'（河之正身主槽）与汉字'港路'、音 càng lõi 合证

entries.zh: 溪心：溪流中央，河床正中
entries.en: the middle of the stream; midstream bed of a river
entries.notes: 官话栏[残]；西语 'madre del río' 与汉字'溪心'、音 quey sīm 合证

entries.zh: 契母：教母（洗礼结契之义母）
entries.en: godmother (contract mother at baptism)
entries.notes: 官话栏[残]，唯 madrina=教母 与汉字'契母'、音 quěy bó 互证明确，故仅因栏损降级

entries.zh: 早早醒起来：一大早起身，天未明即醒起
entries.en: to rise very early, wake and get up before dawn (Sp. madrugar)
entries.notes: 官话栏[残]且音写含 T99 污损；西语 'Madugar' 按 madrugar（早起）理解，与汉字'早…醒起来'互证

entries.zh: 未光醒起来：天未亮就起身
entries.en: to get up before daybreak, while it is still dark
entries.notes: 官话栏[残]且音写含 T99 污损；闽南语'未光'即天未亮，与 madrugar 之义相合

entries.zh: 熟（啦）：果实成熟；（人）成熟
entries.en: ripe (of fruit); mature
entries.notes: 汉字栏[空]、官话栏 'būi ley aunoloyin' 难解，据西语 maduro/madura（熟）与音写 'seg la'（熟啦）推定

entries.zh: 帅：将帅、统帅（maese de campo 之对译）
entries.en: commander, chief of troops (maese de campo = maestro de campo)
entries.notes: 汉字存疑（帥/卽两读）且官话栏[残]，据西语 maese de campo 之军职义与音写推定为统帅义

entries.zh: 兵官：武官，统兵之官
entries.en: military officer; troop commander
entries.notes: 官话栏[残]，据西语 maese de campo 与汉字'兵官'、音 pēng cūã 互证定释义

entries.zh: 兵马司：掌兵马之官（明代五城兵马司一类职衔）
entries.en: bingmasi, officer in charge of troops (a Ming military/city-office title)
entries.notes: 官话栏[残]，据汉字'兵马司'与西语 maese decampo 比照定为掌兵马武职

entries.zh: 将军：统军之将
entries.en: general; commander of armies
entries.notes: 官话栏 'capitan Gl.' 之缩写展开为 capitán general 系推断，余三栏（将军/chiàng cūn）互证清晰

entries.zh: 总管：总揽事务之首领；亦用作统兵总管职衔
entries.en: superintendent, chief steward; commander-general (title)

entries.zh: 海道：掌海防海道之官员（海防道）；海上统将
entries.en: haidao, maritime-defense circuit intendant; commander at sea ('maese de campo del mar')

entries.zh: 师：师傅、师长（教习之人）
entries.en: master; teacher

entries.zh: 先生：老师；对师长、先生之称谓
entries.en: teacher; master; honorific 'Sir/Mister'
entries.notes: 官话栏 'cūn' 之义难解，语义据西语 maestro 与汉字'先生'及音写 fiēnseñ/fīñsẽ 定夺

entries.zh: 教学：教书授业（教与学）
entries.en: to teach and learn; instruction
entries.notes: 西语 'ßenseñama bien'（疑为 enséñame bien 一类教学用语）之释读系推断，据汉字'教学'与音 cà ó 定释义
